tests: R5 reads calculation (the computed fact, its method as written, its inputs with their grades, its checks)

R5 the spot-check: the draw (the set, its size, the seed and method, that anyone can repeat it), the question, each drawn item with its visits and standing, the counts, the estimate with its exact range
R5 the estimate's exact range is drawn from the owner's low and high shares (figures), never NaN
R5 a disagreeing item's visits are drawn in tension, never one picked
R5 the acts: calculationcreate, tabledeclare, recordcheck, calculationaccept, addworkbook, bind, calculationdraw (how many, the seed recorded)
R34 R5 the draw's set is chosen among the tables this calculation reads, by the title of the document each was made from, and the real store draws it
R14 "Record what you saw at a report" sends testify (her own words) and "Count it for the drawn report" sends spotcheckvisit tying it to the drawn item with her finding: two acts
R5 R14 spotcheckvisit needs her testimony and a finding (control: none sends nothing); a refusal drawn beside it
R11 "How spot-checks work" is reached from calculation and says, in plain words, what a spot-check does, why the draw is random and recorded, what the result says and does not say
R34 the calculation's tabled content, workbook and photo are chosen among documents by title, never typed as fingerprints

R7 reads the action's clock entry (action) and its standing proposals (clockproposals); draws its basis, the day received, the days counted, each day skipped with its source, and when it falls due, in the action's zone

R4 a value its source does not state is drawn undetermined and opens the row's panel at that item, with the evidence that would help
R4 a filter keeps only the rows with something undetermined (its address), and back
a figure proposed and then excluded is one row of the trail, not two (money R32)

R4 "Ask the city for the record" opens request for the project

R4 C8 control: a project with none says so and offers only Start a money trail; a refused read draws no list

tests: R6 reads the proceeding (entity: its caption, court and neutral label), its parties by role (partiesof), its register as followed (follows, the newest new), and the orders held as obligations (dutiesof), each with its due date
R6 entitycreate "Register the proceeding" from its caption: court, number, a neutral label, the member's note; then it opens
R6 recordline "Add a party by role"; followregister (a register needing a login says filings come only by capture); declare "Hold an order as obligations"; courtlink
R6 declare names its order: with the other fields filled and no court order chosen, nothing is sent
R6 each act names what it needs (control: nothing sent), and a refusal is drawn beside the act

R16 Follow its register sends proceeding, the screen's own entity id, and the register list shows only the follows follows answers with that proceeding; control: a register followed from another proceeding's screen is not listed here
R28 Dates reads proceedingdates and draws today's stage and two lanes, the proceeding's own and our deadlines on it, never interleaved, each date by cs.date; nothing is drawn as late
R28 control: a body's own deadline is never in the group's lane; with no dates, proceeding.dates.none
R36 the court is chosen among the registered forums (entitieskind with forum_kind, as record data), never among the people; the kind among the forum's, worded by proceeding.kind.<kind>
R36 with no forum held the screen draws court.none in its fold and the Add a court form; adding one lists it and chooses it; control: a refusal of the store is drawn by its words
R34 recordline chooses the document by title; with no document the choice's empty state is drawn and nothing is sent

R47 a proceeding is offered every kind the active profiles name for the forum: a profile kind with a label is offered for a commission forum and sent as kind; control: a kind of another forum_kind is not offered
R47 an affordances answer without the key draws the choice failed, never as no kinds; [] draws empty in place of the choice and sends nothing; a forum with no kind in the profile offers none

outside.waitsOn: this module
tests: R3 reads timeline over the project's set (the people and events its document cites), and each event for who took part and its grade
R3 two lanes, "What they did" and "What we did"; each event with its date as precise as its source states it, who decided or took part, and its grade
R3 an event whose order is undetermined is drawn so, with the evidence that would order it, never guessed into order; undated events are listed apart
R3 createevent from a passage; addparticipant; relate "Link events" and "Cite which came first"; recorddatedfact (a day or a month); each read again after
R3 each act names its passage (control: with no document held, none sends nothing)
R3 hypothesishold keeps a suspected cause as a hunch beside one of the project's questions, never evidence; findin opens find-in over the project
R20 each event of "What they did" draws its participants (entity, role, vote) with grades, and the event's grade; an event placed nowhere draws its grade_why; at most 50 with "and <n> more"
R20 two events ordered by a cited relation are marked "order cited, not dated", their relation a reference; control: a pair dates order is never offered "Cite which came first"
R33 (1) state a draws, after the two lanes, Progressions it follows: each matter a reference to its steps, with its progression, steps threaded and findings

R33 (2) state b: one matter's steps in order with each document, its own date and who threaded it; a step with no document draws the finding's own sentence; never overdue or late; the chain undetermined below two placed steps; findings listed

R33 (2) state b over the world: a matter threaded at a later step alone says, at the missing step, the finding's own sentence (progressions R49: a missing_predecessor finding carries `says`), or that the deadline cannot be placed; never composed here
R33 (2) the matter's acts: thread keeps the placements it holds and adds the chosen document at the chosen step; a lawful skip with its reason and citation; set a finding aside with a reason
R33 (3) state c: a progression's steps (what comes before, how soon, required, how many), its basis with every version, Revise the steps and Define a progression send progressiondefine

R34 the timeline's event form chooses the project's documents by title and sends the capture's digest; no field names a fingerprint; with no document the choice's empty state is drawn and nothing is sent
R45 each finding draws its state by key (a deferred one "Deferred", a set-aside one "Set aside"), explained by progression.finding.state.help; control: a finding with no decision draws Open
R45 the Define and Revise step fields are labelled by the six keys in order, with the steps help under Define and the revise help under Revise
R60 a team with no active place has no time zone: the hint (screen.timeline.nozone) is drawn once above the events placed in no zone; control: a team with an active place draws none
R62 the walker's case: a team that stated its time zone with no place draws no hint; control: a team with neither draws it
R63 R65 the walker's case: a party added to a payment event draws the entity's name and no ENT- id
K3996 an event placed nowhere draws its grade_why, {key, vars}, through its word; control: a bare string draws none of our English
R49 the project's timeline always offers Define a progression, even where it follows no matter yet; pressing it sends progressiondefine with the declared fields and opens the new flow
R49 a progression address of a key the record does not hold draws the empty state with the define form beside it; control: a known flow is drawn as today, with its steps and the one define form
R33 B14 the module names instance and progression among the timeline's acts, and draws each as the design does: the section it reads carries the act (data-act), never a button; the three states

R33 (4) the addresses: the project is state a, <project>/matter/<progression>/<entity> is state b and <project>/progression/<progression> is state c, each on the timeline screen with the reads it names; control: a matter address with no entity is not state b

R33 (5) the set the timeline reads is built from every dated document fact, not only from the entity and event references the project cites: both lists are sent together and each document's dated facts are drawn; control: a document of another project adds none

outside.waitsOn: this module
tests: R33 (1) state a draws, after the two lanes, Progressions it follows: each matter a reference to its steps, with its progression, steps threaded and findings

R33 (2) state b: one matter's steps in order with each document, its own date and who threaded it; a step with no document draws the finding's own sentence; never overdue or late; the chain undetermined below two placed steps; findings listed

R33 (2) state b over the world: a matter threaded at a later step alone says, at the missing step, the finding's own sentence (progressions R49: a missing_predecessor finding carries `says`), or that the deadline cannot be placed; never composed here
R33 (3) state c: a progression's steps (what comes before, how soon, required, how many), its basis with every version, Revise the steps and Define a progression send progressiondefine
R33 (5) a project whose documents name no entity or event but hold dated facts draws Dated in the documents and no event, and not the no-set sentence; control: a project with no document says so
R45 each finding draws its state by key (a deferred one "Deferred", a set-aside one "Set aside"), explained by progression.finding.state.help; control: a finding with no decision draws Open
R33 B14 the module names instance and progression among the timeline's acts, and draws each as the design does: the section it reads carries the act (data-act), never a button; the three states

R33 (4) the addresses: the project is state a, <project>/matter/<progression>/<entity> is state b and <project>/progression/<progression> is state c, each on the timeline screen with the reads it names; control: a matter address with no entity is not state b

R33 (5) the set the timeline reads is built from every dated document fact, not only from the entity and event references the project cites: both lists are sent together and each document's dated facts are drawn; control: a document of another project adds none
